verdict.rationale: Instinct shows event-driven, proactive behavior. Docs and reviewers say it follows up on dropped threads and proactively calls or texts the user, and in one test it noticed an overdue appointment and booked it. One reviewer delegated ongoing podcast-booking follow-ups to it, and it pinged him only when needed, which works like a standing natural-language instruction. However, this is mostly the agent deciding on its own when to act, not the user defining rules that trigger actions on events. Missing for 10: any documented way for users to define explicit rules or triggers (event→action), any rule management or visibility of configured automations, and any documentation of supported event sources or trigger conditions.
